launches.title: Chakra: AI interviewer that finally works
launches.tagline: An AI interviewer that's trained to evaluate AI-first skills across roles with integrity built-in
launches.body:
I’m Vivek, Co-founder and CEO at HackerRank (YC S11). We’re launching a new product - Chakra: an AI Interviewer that actually helps hiring teams screen candidates faster with evidence-backed interview reports.

**The problem we see**

We’re seeing recruiters and hiring managers are dealing with:

* Too many applicants and too much scheduling overhead for early rounds.
* Lower signal-to-noise because many applications are polished by AI or outright fabricated .
* Rising interview integrity issues — including tools marketed to “cheat” during interviews.

Teams spend tons of valuable human time on the wrong candidates - and hiring managers don’t trust early-round signals.

**What Is Chakra**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=97749&key=user_uploads/10668/d2057e04-0171-4320-9e63-77ae90329042)

\
\
Chakra is an AI Interviewer by HackerRank that runs structured, voice/video screening interviews based on your rubric and delivers decision-ready reports backed by evidence.

Demo video - <https://youtu.be/6v5h-7Q4O2c>  

**How it works**

1. Configure the role, competencies, and rubric in a chat-based setup.
2. Invite candidates easily via email, a simple link, or directly through your ATS
3. Chakra conducts a voice/video based interview on your behalf, intelligently adapting to get the signals you need.
4. You get an instant report with an actionable recommendation, skill-level feedback aligned with your rubric, transcript references, and full session replay.

**What makes it different**

There are a lot of “AI interviewers” right now, but most fall into one of two buckets:

1. Niche / single-skill evaluators, or
2. Single-modal experiences that don’t generate robust, trustworthy signal

Chakra is designed to be multi-modal (voice, video, IDE, whiteboard etc.) and versatile across roles, while still producing grounded, auditable evidence in the report.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=97749&key=user_uploads/10668/43e35ddd-bdde-4c00-b579-324bdc45b650)

**YC community asks / offers**

* If you’re hiring right now, you can try [this sample FDE interview](https://www.chakra.sh/interviewer/1enskc0p2qs/session), I’d love feedback on:
  * Rubric setup (does it match how you actually hire?)
  * Candidate experience (does it feel fair and natural?)
  * Report quality (is it truly decision-ready?)
* You can request access at [chakra.sh](http://chakra.sh)
* Or simply reach me at @rvivek on X or via email at [vivek@hackerrank.com](mailto:vivek@hackerrank.com)

launches.title: OneSignal is powering Autonomous Lifecycle Marketing for B2C Companies
launches.tagline: Announcing our Autonomous Lifecycle Marketing Vision and new products including OneSignal AI, Brand Center, MCP, and Slack Agent
launches.body:
Hi Launch YC,

I'm the founder and CEO of OneSignal. Today, we're announcing our new AI vision, and I'm excited to share it with the Launch YC community.

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=r7ccDbGVJ5U>

**The problem**

OneSignal first went through YC as a mobile gaming company called Hiptic Games.

After pivoting away from mobile games, we used our experience to uncover an opportunity to truly "Make something people want," and began working toward a mission to Democratize Customer Engagement for B2C companies.

For years, most B2C marketing automation products have had lengthy implementation processes, dated interfaces, and a learning curve steep enough that many teams hire a full-time expert. Many of them were also built in a world where email was the dominant channel, and have zero or weak support campaigns that span across Email, Mobile Push, SMS/RCS, and other channels.

In contrast, we made OneSignal incredibly easy to use from the start: customers can get going for free with an intuitive product experience, a powerful suite of tools for omni-channel messaging, and the performance to support some of the largest brands in the world. Today, OneSignal sends billions of daily messages for hundreds of thousands of active apps.

But no matter how easy and powerful we made the product, marketers still needed to bring a lot of their own time and expertise to get the best results from their campaigns.

**The solution**

Today, I'm excited to announce our vision and the products that will make lifecycle marketing autonomous. Our mission is still to Democratize Customer Engagement, but with AI we can achieve it in ways that were never possible before. This AI vision enables us to empower under-resourced marketing teams with the time and expertise that has seemed always out of reach.

We've broken this mission into phases, which we think of as an autonomy ladder. Most marketers don't want to hand the keys to an autonomous system on day one, so we'll roll out features that build the systems and trust needed at each step.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=105807&key=user_uploads/5571/09a43a18-3ca8-4268-bd70-ab1798220546)

**Level 0 — Manual.** The dashboard. A marketer drives every click, and the team scales by hiring. This is where the entire category has lived.

**Level 1 — Assistance.** AI drafts copy, suggests audiences, and explains your analytics in plain language. You review and ship. This is live today.

**Level 2 — Expert Assist.** AI becomes proactive. It recommends campaigns to fill lifecycle gaps, flags mistakes, and checks your work. Your input is still required.

**Level 3 — Agentic Autopilot.** You delegate bounded work, and AI does it within the scope and rules you've defined. You approve work in batches.

**Level 4 — Full Operator.** You set the goals and the guardrails. AI plans, sends, tests, and improves campaigns against them, reaching out only when it needs you.

**What we're launching today**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=105807&key=user_uploads/5571/da0aff66-9335-4ac3-87bf-d61aaa95b014)

**OneSignal AI** — An in-product agent that can do everything a person can: generate message copy, design emails, analyze message performance, and recommend next steps to maximize user engagement. Best of all, it can create and analyze complex multi-step Journeys, saving hours of work.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=105807&key=user_uploads/5571/f96522b2-51f9-404c-83fe-5b8bcbf4618a)

**Brand Kit** — Define your audience, voice and tone, industry, and visual assets on a centralized configuration page or pull them automatically from your website. Set guardrails for language to avoid. OneSignal AI uses your Brand Kit when generating copy, email designs, and in-app messages.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=105807&key=user_uploads/5571/b4c791bc-66cd-4849-afbf-d6921338d492)

**OneSignal MCP** — Brings OneSignal's capabilities to the AI tools and agents you already use. The MCP is available now on the ChatGPT and Cursor marketplaces, coming soon to the Claude marketplace, and available through Smithery for any other AI client. Together, the MCP and the OneSignal API make it possible to use the platform in a fully headless way.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=105807&key=user_uploads/5571/16f8ec08-92f4-4612-b342-555017d5082b)

Soon, we'll also release a OneSignal Slack Agent, bringing the capabilities of OneSignal AI and the OneSignal MCP to where your team already spends its time. And we'll be rolling out an API to create, edit, and analyze Journeys, so your team can set up complex campaigns without ever logging into the OneSignal dashboard.

**Try it today**

All of these features are available on OneSignal's free plan. Small companies can send unlimited push notifications and up to 10,000 emails per month for free. Paid plans start at $19/mo plus affordable usage-based pricing. Installing OneSignal is as simple as copying a prompt into Claude Code. You can get started at https://onesignal.com

name: Launchpad Toys
long_description:
We're creating digital toys and tools that empower kids to create, learn & share their ideas through play.

Give a young child a couple of toys or a box of crayons and he or she is likely to play for hours, deeply engrossed in an imaginary world. In both art and dramatic play, children construct settings, create fictional characters, and act out fantastic storylines that would be the envy of many Hollywood scriptwriters. Yet, ask that same child to write out a story in a blank notebook or a word processor and you would be lucky to capture a fraction of the depth and splendor of his or her imagination. Play inspires and scaffolds the creative process from an early age, but there is a persistent gap between the origins of imaginative play (ages 4-5) and kids' adoption of the formal discipline of creative writing (ages 8-10).

At Launchpad Toys, we're using mobile devices like the iPad to bridge this gap between informal and formal learning, to harness the power of play to help children capture and share their ideas with other kids around the world. Our first product, Toontastic an app for the iPad, is a creative learning tool that blends constructionist and social development theories to empower young children to create, learn, and share their ideas through play.
one_liner: Creativity at Play.  Tablet toys.   Acquired by Google, 2015.

name: Imgix
long_description:
Nobody should have to employ expensive imaging scientists and engineers for their business to get the most out of their visual media. This is where imgix has your back. imgix is a platform for managing, processing, rendering, optimizing, and delivering your existing visual assets so that you can meet the demands of your business and your team can stay focused on what they do best.

The business demands on web visual media can blindside even the most hyper-aware content teams and developers. Just to be competitive on the Internet, you need your images to be sized perfectly to every device, served in one of any of a half dozen web formats, optimized to the absolute best perceptual quality while maintaining pinpoint performance, and distributed to wherever your users are, anywhere in the world. And that is just the baseline. Next-level imaging concerns like copyright, licensing, accessibility, moderation, illegal or explicit content, "fake news", and more, can threaten your business at any moment if not handled properly. Get any of these things wrong and you are shedding revenue, ceding ground to competitors, and potentially exposing your business to extreme liability.

By working with imgix's powerful APIs, SDKs, user interfaces, and integrations, you can rest assured that any demands on your images and videos will always be met, now and into the future, without you having to invest in building it yourself or patching together a mishmash of open source and third-party technologies. Our platform is designed to ensure that your images are always working for your business and never against it.

imgix was launched through the famed Y Combinator accelerator program. Its customers include Google, Lyft, Kickstarter, AirBnb, Coursera, Bonobos, Spotify, Vimeo, Bustle, and many others.
one_liner: The platform for your visual media.
